title: Earned-work customer-experience projection (proposed)
purpose: Independent Wave 4 CX packs project the same honesty labels and next actions from pinned F01/F04/F17/I01 HTTP and schema. This file does not replace kernel, terms, verifier, or ledger contracts. Do not copy those types here.

productDistinction.accepted: verdict pass with bound evidence; not money
productDistinction.owed: typed obligation exists; transfer is null on the prototype rail
productDistinction.paid: a paying rail recorded submitted; this prototype never projects paid
productDistinction.settled: a paying rail confirmed after reconcile; this prototype never projects settled
productDistinction.payable: owed and destination attached; still not paid
productDistinction.claimable: funding reserved, reservation not expired, exclusive occupancy free
productDistinction.pending: in-flight claim/submit/verdict; not a payout state

identity.payoutDestination: optional; attached after owed via F04 POST /v1/obligations/{id}/destination
identity.reputation: receipt-grounded dossier; never a universal numeric score

termsVersion.note: I01 OpenAPI TermsVersion. F01-on-main-absent integer residual is a seeded failure, not a consumer default.

nonpayingPrototype.bankedUsdc: 8.105 is historical revenue, not spendable funds
